title: Prototype Test Track Rig Setup & Accelerometer Sensor Calibration
description: Intermediate technical English module analyzing prototype test track rig setup & accelerometer sensor calibration.
learning_objectives: Master professional Passive Voice with Modals in automotive engineering
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in prototype test track rig setup & accelerometer sensor calibration
Demonstrate precision in technical and regulatory documentation

questions.prompt: The test engineer noticed that the dynamic accelerometer _____ securely onto the backbone tube chassis before the high-speed gravel run began.

explanations.correct: Past Perfect Passive ('had been mounted') expresses an action completed prior to the past reference point 'began'.
explanations.wrong_A: Active continuous 'was mounting' does not fit passive sensor installation.
explanations.wrong_C: Present Perfect 'has mounted' cannot connect to a past narrative.
explanations.wrong_D: Active past simple 'didn't mount' is grammatically incorrect for passive equipment.

questions.cz_learning_point: Děj, který proběhl před jiným dějem v minulosti ('before the run began'), vyžaduje předminulý čas v trpném rodě: 'had been mounted'.

questions.prompt: If the telemetry transceiver _____ signal with the base station on the Kopřivnice test polygon, the onboard logger stores raw vibration data internally.

explanations.correct: First conditional rule: Present Simple ('loses') in the conditional clause for real operational contingencies.
explanations.wrong_A: 'will' cannot be used in a conditional if-clause.
explanations.wrong_B: 'would' cannot be used in a real First Conditional.
explanations.wrong_D: Past tense 'lost' would conflict with present indicative 'stores'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Typická chyba: v podmínkové větě s 'if' se nesmí použít 'will' (*if it will lose*). Použijte přítomný čas: 'if it loses'.

questions.prompt: During the 60 km/h Belgian block test, the suspension transducers registered severe vibrations _____ the rear swinging half-axles.

explanations.correct: 'Across' appropriately describes vibrations distributed throughout or spanning the axle assembly.
explanations.wrong_D: 'between of' is ungrammatical; 'between' does not take 'of'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Předložka 'across' vyjadřuje rozložení vibrací napříč polonápravami. Vyvarujte se chybné vazby *between of*.

questions.prompt: To avoid electromagnetic noise interference from the alternator, all analog sensor cables _____ with grounded braided shielding.

explanations.correct: Passive with modal 'must be routed' correctly indicates cable routing requirements.
explanations.wrong_B: Cables do not route themselves actively.
explanations.wrong_C: Active voice 'must route' lacks an object and misassigns action to cables.

questions.cz_learning_point: Kabely musí být vedeny stíněním: 'must be routed'. Způsobové sloveso s trpným rodem 'be + příčestí minulé'.

questions.prompt: The telemetry technician spent three hours yesterday _____ the multi-channel strain gauge amplifier before zero-point offset calibration.

explanations.correct: The verb structure 'spend time doing something' requires the '-ing' gerund form: 'fine-tuning'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'spend time to do' is ungrammatical in standard English.
explanations.wrong_B: Base form without '-ing' is incorrect after 'spend time'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vazba 'spend time doing something' vyžaduje gerundium s koncovkou -ing: 'spent three hours fine-tuning' (nikoli *to fine-tune*).

questions.prompt: Tatra prototype T-815-7 was driven over the 400 mm vertical obstacle _____ the dynamic wheel travel limits could be evaluated by optical cameras.

explanations.correct: 'So that' is a conjunction of purpose followed by a subject and modal verb clause ('the dynamic wheel travel limits could be evaluated').
explanations.wrong_C: 'because of' is followed by a noun phrase, not a clause with a finite verb.
explanations.wrong_D: 'for' cannot introduce this purpose clause with modal 'could'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Účelová spojka 'so that' = aby (následovaná podmětem a způsobovým slovesem: 'so that limits could be evaluated').

questions.prompt: When reviewing the accelerometer telemetry log, the validation engineer realized that the low-pass Butterworth filter _____ at 200 Hz instead of 500 Hz.

explanations.correct: Past Perfect Passive ('had been set') is required because the filter configuration occurred before the engineer 'realized' it.
explanations.wrong_A: Past simple does not clearly indicate priority before 'realized'.
explanations.wrong_B: Present perfect active is incorrect in voice and tense.
explanations.wrong_C: Present continuous does not fit completed past telemetry recording.

questions.cz_learning_point: Čeština používá v obou větách minulý čas. V angličtině vyžaduje děj předcházející minulému okamžiku předminulý čas: 'had been set'.

questions.prompt: The NATO STANAG test protocol requires that each triaxial sensor _____ re-zeroed immediately after every heavy obstacle impact test.

explanations.correct: The mandative subjunctive following 'requires that' uses the base form 'be' in formal technical documentation.
explanations.wrong_B: Indicative 'is' is informal and less appropriate in formal standard specifications.
explanations.wrong_C: Future 'will be' is incorrect after mandative 'requires that'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Subjunktiv po slovesech požadavku ('requires that each sensor be re-zeroed') používá základní tvar 'be', nikoli *is* nebo *will be*.

questions.prompt: Why _____ the mobile DAQ (Data Acquisition) unit shut down unexpectedly during the cross-country trench crossing trial?

explanations.correct: Past Simple question with base verb 'shut down' requires auxiliary 'did': 'Why did the unit shut down?'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'has' would require past participle and doesn't fit specific past event 'during the trial'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'was' with 'shut down' would form a passive without subject-verb agreement or agent.
explanations.wrong_D: 'does' is present tense, incompatible with completed trial.

questions.cz_learning_point: Tvoření otázek v minulém čase: tázací způsobové pomocné sloveso 'did' + podmět + základní tvar slovesa ('Why did the unit shut down?').

questions.prompt: Unless the pneumatic tire pressure monitoring sensors are recalibrated for cold-weather conditions, the rolling resistance data _____ invalid.

explanations.correct: First conditional result clause takes 'will + base verb' ('will remain') paired with present condition 'Unless... are recalibrated'.
explanations.wrong_A: Present simple in the main clause expresses timeless general truth rather than future predictive consequence.
explanations.wrong_C: Third conditional form conflicts with present conditional clause.
explanations.wrong_D: Past tense cannot serve as the main clause for a present condition.

questions.cz_learning_point: První kondicionál (First Conditional): Pokud je v podmínce přítomný čas (Unless sensors are...), v hlavní větě musí být budoucí čas: 'will remain'.
